sa: तत एनं महाबाहुर्बाहुभ्याममरोपमः। समुत्क्षिप्य बलाद् भीमो विनिष्पिष्य महीतले॥
en: Then the celestials-like and mighty-armed Bhima lifted him up with his two arms; and dashing him with force on the ground.

sa: न वासयेत् पारवर्यं द्विषन्तं विशेषतः क्षत्तरहितं मनुष्यम्। स यत्रेच्छसि विदुर तत्र गच्छ सुसान्त्विता ह्यसती स्त्री जहाति॥
en: O be should not give shelter to one who is a friend of his enemy, or to one who is always jealous of his protector. O Vidura, therefore go away wherever you like. An unchaste wife, however well-treated, (always) forsakes her husband.

sa: तेन रैभ्यस्य वै पुत्रावर्वावसुपरावसू। वृतौ संहायौ सत्रार्थं बृहद्द्युम्नेनधीमता॥
en: The two sons of Raivya, named Arvavasu and Paravasu, were employed by the intelligent Brihadyumna to assist him in the sacrifice.

sa: अकामानां च सर्वेषां सुहृदामर्थदर्शिनाम्। अकरोत् पाण्डवाह्वानं धृतराष्ट्रः सुतप्रियः॥
en: But disregarding the counsels of all his wise friends and relatives, Dhritarashtra ever partial to his sons, (again) summoned the Pandavas.

sa: पौरजानपदाः सर्वे प्रायशः कुरुनन्दन। सवृद्धबालसहिताः शंसन्ति त्वां युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O Yudhishthira, all the citizens and the inhabitants of the country, both young and old, praise you.

sa: यथा देवैः स मे भर्ता विहितो निषधाधिपः। तेन सत्येन मे देवास्तमेव प्रदिशन्तु मे॥
en: When it was settled to me by the celestials that the prince of the Nishadhas should be my husband; for the sake of that truth it behoves the celestials to point him to me.

sa: प्रत्यहन्यन्त ते सर्वे गदामासाद्य सायकाः। न वेगंधारयामासुर्गदावेगस्य वेगिताः॥
en: But all these arrows though discharged with force, on reaching the mace fell back and could not check its onward career.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरवचः श्रुत्वा भीमसेनपुरोगमाः। प्रहृष्टवदनाः सर्वे समुत्तस्थुर्नरर्षभाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard the words of Yudhishthira, those foremost of men headed by Bhimasena rose up in great delight.

sa: असत्स्त्रीणां समाचारं सत्ये मामनुपृच्छसि। असदाचरिते मार्गे कथं स्यादनुकीर्तनम्॥
en: “O Satyabhama, you ask me of the practices of wicked women. How can I speak of practices adopted by wicked women?

sa: मन्दीभूते तु पवने तस्मिन् रजसि शाम्यति। महद्भिर्जलधारौघैर्वर्षमभ्याजगाम ह॥
en: When the wind had abated and the dust had subsided, there came down a heavy shower of rain in great torrents.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा किरातस्यार्जुनस्तदा। रोषमाहारयामास ताडयामास चेषुभिः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of the Kirata, Arjuna, grew angry and began to strike him with numerous arrows.

sa: समये तं पिता राज्ये बृहदश्वोऽभ्यषेचयत्। कुवलाश्वं महाराज शूरमुत्तमधार्मिकम्॥
en: O great king, in due time his father Brihadashva installed that foremost of heroes and virtuous men, Kuvalashva, on the throne.

sa: तान् समापततो राजन् गन्धर्वाञ्छतशो रणे। प्रत्यगृह्णन् नरव्याघ्राः शरवर्षैरनेकशः॥
en: O king, those foremost of men attacked with showers of arrows thousands and thousands of Gandharvas who were rushing towards them.

sa: कन्दरांश्च नितम्बांश्च नदीश्चाद्भुतदर्शनाः। ददर्श तान् भीमसुता पतिमन्वेषती तदा॥
en: That daughter of Bhima saw, when roaming in quest of her husband, many caverns and ridges and rivulets of amazing sight.

sa: सत्यात् प्रच्यवमानानां व्याधयो बहवोऽभवन्। कामाचोपद्रवाश्चैव तदा वै दैवकारिताः॥
en: When men fall off from truth, they become subject to various diseases, lust overtakes men and natural calamities fall on them.

sa: ततोऽहं शरवर्षेण महता कुरुनन्दन। मार्गमावृत्य दैत्यानां गतिं चैषामवारयम्॥
en: Thereupon, O descendant of the Kurus, covering the passage of the Daityas by heavy shower of arrows, I obstructed their movement.

sa: ततः पितृन् यथान्यायं तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि। मन्दरं शैलराजं तमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Thereupon duly and according to the ordinances offering oblation to the manes he began to invoke Mandara the king of mountains.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत् काननं प्राप्य नरेन्द्रपुत्राः सुखोचिता वासमुपेत्य कृच्छ्रम्। विजह्वरिन्द्रप्रतिमाः शिवेषु सरस्वतीशालवनेषु तेषु॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having arrived at that forest those princes resembling Indra, (formerly) used to happiness, (but now) labouring under misfortune, began to sport in that sacred forest of Shala trees washed by Sarasvati.

sa: यस्तु केवलसंरम्भात् प्रपातं न निरीक्षते। पापात्मा पापबुद्धिर्यः पापमेवानुवर्तते॥
en: He who does not foresee his fall through anger and he who through wicked-mindedness and vicious tendency is addicted to sin,

sa: भीमसेनस्य नादेन व्यमुञ्चन्त गुहा भयात्। क्वचित् प्रधावंस्तिष्ठंश्च क्वचिच्चोपविशंस्तथा॥
en: Terrified by the yells of Bhimasena, left their lairs through fear. At some places running, some sitting and at others resting.

sa: दमो दानं बलं बुद्धिींकृतिस्तेज उत्तमम्। एतान्यपि महासत्त्वे स्थितान्यमिततेजसि॥
en: In that high-souled being of unrivalled energy reside all these (qualities) of selfcontrol, charity, strength, intelligence, modesty, patience and excellent energy.

sa: सधर्मराजमालक्ष्य भ्राता भ्रातरमग्रजम्। कथयामास तत् सर्वं ग्रहणादि विचेष्टितम्॥
en: beholding his elder brother Dharmaraja, he narrated to him fully as to how he came into the clutches of the serpent.

sa: प्रशशंसुश्च सुप्रीता नलं ता विस्मयान्विताः। न चैनमभ्यभाषन्त मनोभिस्त्वभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: Filled with amazement and highly gratified, they praised Nala; but they spoke nothing to him, only worshipped him in the mind.

sa: ततस्तं हृष्टमनसं पाण्डवान् प्रति भारत। समीक्ष्य यक्षगन्धर्वा निर्विकारमवस्थिताः॥
en: Then, O Bharata, the Yakshas and Rakshasas seeing that he (Kubera) was well pleased with the Pandavas stood there with indifferent.

sa: उष्णतोयवहा गङ्गां शीततोयवहा पुरा। सुवर्णसिकता राजन् विशालां बदरीमनु॥
en: O king, near Badari the cool waters of Ganga were formerly hot and her banks were over-spread with sands of gold.

sa: यतीनामगृहाणां ते तथैव गृहमेधिनाम्। दीयते भोजनं राजन्नतीवगुणवत् प्रभो॥
en: O lord, best food was given by you to ascetics, the houseless and those leading domestic lives, like an accomplished king.

sa: सिकता वपन् सव्यसाची राजानमनुगच्छति। माद्रीपुत्रः सहदेवो मुखमालिप्य गच्छति॥
en: Savyasachi (Arjuna) has followed the king, (Yudhisthira) scattering sands along. The son of Madri, Sahadeva proceeds (the way) besmearing his face.

sa: मत्कराग्रविनिर्मुक्ता दानवानां शरास्तथा। अङ्गेषु रुचिरापाङ्गा विविशुः शलभा इव॥
en: The beautiful arrows discharged from the fore part of my hand penetrated into the bodies of the Danavas like biting insects.

sa: तामिल्वलेन महता स्वरेण वाचमीरिताम्। श्रुत्वातिमायो बलवान् क्षिप्रं ब्राह्मणकण्टकः॥
en: That powerful (Asura) endued with great power of illusion, that thorn to the Brahmanas, hearing the words loudly uttered by Ilvala,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः शकुनिना राजा दुर्योधनस्ततः। धृतराष्ट्रमिदं वाक्यमपदान्तरमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed by Shakuni, the king Duryodhana, without allowing a moment to elapse, spoke thus to Dhritarashtra.

sa: ऋष्यशृङ्ग उवाच ऋद्ध्या भवाङ्योतिरिव प्रकाशते। मन्ये चाहं त्वामभिवादनीयम्। पाद्यं वै ते सम्प्रदास्यामि कामाद् यथाधर्मं फलमूलानि चैव॥
en: Rishyashringa said : You are shining with luster like the light. I consider you worthy of obeisance. I shall give you water to wash your feet and also fruits and roots as will be liked by you according to my religious ordinance.

sa: अकृतास्त्रं कृतास्त्रश्चं दुर्बलं बलवत्तरः। एवं कर्मसु सर्वेषु निकृत्यैव युधिष्ठिर। विद्वानविदुषोऽभ्येति नाहुस्तां निकृति जनाः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, so also a man skilled in weapons approaches one who is not so; so does a strong man a weak one. This is the practice in every contest. The victory is(always)the motive.

sa: तत इन्द्रो यवक्रीतमुपगम्य युधिष्ठिर। अब्रवीत् कस्य हेतोस्त्वमास्थितस्तप उत्तमम्॥
en: O Yudhishthira, thereupon Indra went to him and thus spoke to him, 'Why have you been engaged in the severe austerities?

sa: गच्छाव यज्ञं जनकस्य राज्ञो बह्वाश्चर्यः श्रूयते तस्य यज्ञः। मर्थं चायं तत्र भोक्ष्यावहे च॥
en: “Let us go to the sacrifice of the king Janaka. We hear of many wonderful things in that sacrifice. We shall hear controversies there among the Brahmanas and (we shall also) eat excellent food.

sa: अलावुमध्यान्निष्कृष्य बीजं यलेन गोप्यताम्। सोपस्वेदेषु पात्रेषु घृतपूर्णेषु भागशः॥
en: Take out the seeds from the gourd and let inem be preserved with care in họt vessels partly filled with Ghee.

sa: बुद्ध्याथ कथं हि देवाञ्जानीयां कथं विद्यां नलं नृपम्। एवं संचिन्तयन्ती सा वैदर्भी भृशदुःखिता॥
en: 'How shall I discern the gods and how shall I ascertain prince Nala?' This thought engrossed the mind of the daughter of the king of the Vidarbhas and also afflicted her with great grief.

sa: अचेतनं जीवगुणं वदन्ति स चेष्टते चेष्टयते च सर्वम्। ततः परं क्षेत्रविदो वदन्ति प्राक्लपयद् यो भुवनानि सप्त॥
en: Inert and insensible matter is the seat of the living principle which is active in itself and induces activity in others. That by which the seven worlds are incited to action is called the most high by men of high spiritual insight.

sa: ततः परमसंहृष्टः प्रद्युम्नः शरमुत्तमम्। संजहारधनुःश्रेष्ठात् तूणे चैव न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Thereupon that excellent hero, Pradyumna, withdrew that foremost of arrows from his excellent bow and kept it back into his quiver.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु शक्रेण कलिः कोपसमन्वितः। देवानामन्त्र्य तान् सर्वानुवाचेदं वचस्तदा॥
en: Thus spoken to by Shakra, Kali, the viler among the celestials, waxing worth, said to them (celestials) all, the following words:

sa: ब्राह्मणांश्चापि तान् सर्वान् समुपादाय राक्षसाः। नियोगाद् राक्षसेन्द्रस्य जग्मुर्भीमपराक्रमाः॥
en: Being ordered by the Rakshasas chief, other greatly powerful Rakshasas took up all the Brahmanas (on their shoulders) and proceeded along.

sa: तेषु तत्रोपविष्टेषु सर्वेष्वध नृपेषु च। शकुनिः सौबलस्तत्र युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: When they were seated, and when the kings took their seats also, the son of Subala, Shakuni, thus spoke to Yudhishthira.

sa: नैषधेनैवमुक्ता सा दमयन्ती वचोऽब्रवीत्। समाप्लुताभ्यां नेत्राभ्यां शोकजेनाथ वारिणा॥
en: Thus addressed by the king of the Nishadhas, Damayanti spoke to him with eyes overflowed by the tears produced by sorrow.

sa: अथ जर्जरसर्वाङ्गं व्यावृत्तनयनोल्वणम्। भूतले भ्रामयामास वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: Then dragging along on the earth the bruised body of the Rakshasas whose eye-lids were about to close, Bhima spoke thus.

sa: परिधावनथ नल इतश्चेतश्च भारत। आससाद सभोद्देशे विकोशं खङ्गमुत्तमम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata's race! walking with hasty steps up and down, Nala obtained, near the inn, an excellent unsheathed sword.

sa: नानारागविरागाणि वसनान्यथ वै प्रभो। प्रादुर्भवन्ति शतशो धर्मस्य परिपालनात्॥
en: O lord, in consequence of the protection (extended towards Draupadi) by Dharma, hundreds and hundreds of cloths of many colour appeared.

sa: तदाप्रभृति कौन्तेय नरा गिरिमिमं सदा। नाशक्नुवन्नभिद्रष्टुं कुत एवाधिरोहितुम्॥
en: O sons of Kunti, from that day men could not even look at these hill, what to speak of ascending them.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच ब्रवीषि सूनृतं धर्म्य यस्य वक्ता न विद्यते। दिव्यप्रभावः सुमहानृषिरेव मतोऽसि मे॥
en: The Brahmana said : You have given a true exposition of virtue which none else is able to do. Your spiritual power is great and you appear to me to be a great Rishi.

sa: तामेवं श्लक्ष्णया वाचा लुब्धको मृदुपूर्वया। सान्त्वयामास कामार्तस्तदबुध्यत भाविनी॥
en: Inflamed with lust, the hunter comforted her mildly and in smooth words. But the graceful Damayanti soon saw through his purposes.

sa: यथा वनं माधवमासि मध्ये समीरितं श्वसनेनेव भाति। तथा स भात्युत्तमपुण्यगन्धी निषेव्यमाणः पवनेन तात॥
en: As the forest in the midst of the vernal season assumed a beauty when fanned by the breeze, O sire, so that excellent and fragrant one assumes a beauty when fanned by the breeze.

sa: यमुनाप्रभवं गत्वा समुपस्पृश्य यामुनम्। अश्वमेधफलं लब्ध्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: Going to Yamunaprabhva he who bathes in the Yamuna obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and becomes adored in the celestials region.

sa: अष्टमेऽहनि सम्प्राप्ते तमृषि लोकविश्रुतम्। आमन्त्र्य वृषपर्वाणं प्रस्थानं प्रत्यरोचयन्॥
en: On the eighth day, greeting the royal sage of world wide renown, they expressed their desire to start on their journey.

sa: योगिनामेष मार्गस्तु येन गच्छन्ति तत् परम्। जितक्लमाः समा धीरा मूर्धन्यात्मानमादधुः। एवं सर्वेषु विततौ प्राणापानौ हि देहिषु॥
en: This is the way, by which go to the highest state, the Yogis who have overcome all difficulties who are patient and self-controlled and who have their souls seated in their brains. The Prana and Apana are thus present in all creatures.

sa: तमस्मै शङ्खमाहादि वारुणं कलशोदधिः। शैक्यं निष्कसहस्रेण सुकृतं विश्वकर्मणा॥
en: That big conch of Varuna which Vishvakarma had constructed with a thousand Nishkas of gold was brought by the Ocean himself.

sa: इह देवास्तदा सर्वे यज्ञानाजहरुत्तमान्। तेषामेतानि लिङ्गानि दृश्यन्तेऽद्यापि भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, here did the celestials perform those best of sacrifices, their marks are seen even to this day.

sa: ततः कार्मुकमादाय भीमसेनो महाबलः। कृष्णामादाय संगम्य तस्थावाश्रित्य पादपम्॥
en: Then taking hold of his bow and taking also Draupadi (by the hand), the greatly powerful Bhimasena stood underneath a tree.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य पर्णादो नाम वै द्विजः। प्रत्येत्य नगरं भैमीमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Brihadashva said : After a very long time, a Brahmana, Parnada by name, came back to the city of the king of the Vidharbhas and spoke to the daughter of king Bhima these words:

sa: मामवज्ञाय दुष्टात्मा यस्मादेव सखा तव। धर्षणां कृतवानेतां पश्यतस्तेधनेश्वर॥
en: Said this 'O Lord of wealth, since your friend, this evil-minded one, despising me, has insulted me in your very presence,

sa: वामदेव उवाच जानामि पुत्रं दशवर्षं तवाह जातं महिष्यां श्येनजितं नरेन्द्र। स्तूर्णं प्रियं सायकै?ररूपैः॥
en: Vamadeva said: O ruler of men, I know you have a son ten years old, born of Shyenajita, your queen, Urged by my word, soon kill your that beloved boy by these fearful arrows

sa: ततो मातलिना सार्धमहं तत् पुरमभ्ययाम्। त्रासयन् स्थघोषेण निवातकवचस्त्रियः॥
en: Then accompanied by Matali, I entered that city, terrifying the females of the Nivatakavachas by the rattling noise of the car.

sa: वैश्वानरस्त्वं पिङ्गेशः प्लवङ्गो भूरितेजसः। कुमारसूस्त्वं भगवान् रुद्रगर्भो हिरण्यकृत्॥
en: Vaishvanara, Pingesha, Plavanga and Bhuritejas. You are the origin of Kumara (Kartikeya). O exalted one, you are called Rudragarbha and Hiranyakrit.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् सत्यधृतिर्धातॄन् सर्वान् युधिष्ठिरः। द्वैपायनस्य वचनं ह्येवं समनुचिन्तयन्॥
en: Thereupon Yudhishthira, ever devoted to truth, thinking all the while the words of Dvaipayana (Vyasa), spoke thus to all his brothers.

sa: तत्राश्रमपदं रम्यं मृगद्विजनिषेवितम्। तत्राश्रमपदे रम्ये बकं पश्यति देवराट्॥
en: It was a charming hermitage frequented by beasts and birds. The king of the celestials saw in that charming hermitage Baka.

sa: अन्येऽस्य युगमच्छिन्दन् ध्वजमन्ये न्यपातयन्। ईषामन्ये हयानन्ये सूतमन्ये न्यपातयन्॥
en: Some cut down the yoke of his car, some its flag-staff, some its shafts, some its horses and some its charioteer.

sa: ततः पर्वतभारार्ता मन्दप्राणविचेष्टिताः। हया मम महाराज वेपमाना इवाभवन्॥
en: O great king, my horses, afflicted with the weight of the rocks and almost at the point of death, stood trembling.

sa: ततोऽहं पर्वतचितः सहयः सहसारथिः। अप्रख्यातिमियां राजन् सर्वतः पर्वतैश्चितः॥
en: O king, being covered with those rocks along with my horses, charioteer, (car with) flag-staff, I altogether disappeared from the view.

sa: ऋत्विगुवाच अस्ति चैतादृशं कर्म येन पुत्रशतं भवेत्। यदि शक्नोषि तत् कर्तुमथ वक्ष्यामि सोमक।।१७।
en: Ritvija said : There is a ceremony by which a man may get one hundred sons. O Somaka, if you are able to perform it, (then tell me); I shall explain it to you?

sa: ततः स हरिभिर्युक्तं जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृतम्। मेघनादिनमारुह्य श्रिया परमया ज्वलन्॥ पार्थानभ्याजगामाथ देवराजः पुरंदरः। आगत्य च सहस्राक्षो स्थादवरुरोह वै॥
en: Then Purandara, the king of the gods, blazing in transcendental beauty and ascending a car, yoked with horses, varnished with gold and roaring like clouds, set out (to meet) the Parthas. Arriving (there) he of hundred eyes got down from the car.

sa: विचेष्टमानस्य च तस्य तानि कूजन्ति हंसाः सरसीव मत्ताः। चीराणि तस्याद्भुतदर्शनानि नेमानि तद्वन्मम रूपवन्ति॥
en: When he moved about, those ornaments made the sound as that of delightful swans on the waters of a tank. His clothes were of extraordinary make; my clothes are not so beautiful as his.

sa: दृष्ट्वैव चोर्वशी पार्थो लज्जासंवृतलोचनः। तदाभिवादनं कृत्वा गुरुपूजां प्रयुक्तवान्॥
en: Seeing Urvashi, Partha closed his eyes form modesty. Then saluting her, he offered her the worship usually offered to a superior.

sa: सभ्यास्त ये तत्र बभूवुरन्ये ताभ्यामृते धार्तराष्ट्रेण चैवा तेषामभूद् दुःखमतीव कृष्णां दृष्ट्वा सभायां परिकृष्यमाणाम्॥
en: Amongst all those that were present in the assembly, except these three and the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana), every one was filled with great sorrow on seeing Krishna (Draupadi) thus dragged in the Sabha.

sa: निषादान् पुरुषादांश्च कर्णप्रावरणानपि। ये च कालमुखा नाम नरराक्षसयोनयः॥
en: Then the Nishadas, the cannibals, the Karnapravanas, those tribes called Kalamukhas who were a cross race between the men and Rakshasas,

sa: समाहूतः केनचिदाद्रवेति नाहं शक्तो भीमसेनापयातुम्। गाण्डीवे च संशयिते कथं नु राज्यप्राप्तिः संशयिता भवेन्नः॥
en: O Bhimasena, if challenged by one who says “Come," I am unable to stay, if our possessions of the Gandiva (bow) be doubtful, then the acquisition of our kingdom again will be (equally) doubtful.”

sa: सरित्सिन्धुरपीयं तु प्रत्यसृग्वाहिनी भृशम्। शृगालिन्यग्निवक्त्रा च प्रत्यादित्यं विराविणी॥
en: The river Sindhu is flowing with a current of fresh blood. The jackals with fiery faces are crying to the sun.

sa: इति चाप्यहमश्रौषं वचस्तेषां दयावताम्। मयि संजातहार्दनामथ तेऽन्तर्हिता द्विजाः॥
en: I heard all these words of those kind-hearted sages who conceived an attachment towards ones me. (And) those twice-born then vanished.

sa: इत्युक्त्वैनमतिक्रुद्धः कक्ष्यामुत्पीड्य पाण्डवः। निष्पिष्य पाणिना पाणिं संदष्टौष्ठपुटो बली॥ तमभ्यधावद् वेगेन भीमो वृक्षायुधस्तदा। यमदण्डप्रतीकाशं ततस्तं तस्य मूर्धनि॥ पातयामास वेगेन कुलिशं मघवानिव। असम्भ्रान्तं तु तद् रक्षः समरे प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: Saying this, the Pandava Bhima tightened the cloth round his waist in anger. Rubbing his palms and biting his nether lips, the heroic Bhima, armed with the tree, rushed towards him. As Maghavata (Indra) hurls his thunderbolt, so he (Bhima) made it (the tree), which was like the mace of Yama, descend with force on his (Kirmira's) head. The Rakshasas was seen to stand in the battle unmoved.

sa: तामुपेत्य महात्मानः सह तैर्ब्राह्मणर्षभैः। अवतेरुस्ततः सर्वे राक्षसस्कन्धतः शनैः॥
en: Having reached the place with those foremost of Brahmanas, the illustrious (Pandavas) all slowly alighted from the shoulders of the Rakshasas.

sa: तु मोघीभूतंधनंजयः। परमं विस्मयं चक्रे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing his shower of arrows had no effects (on his adversary), Dhananjaya (Arjuna) became greatly surprised; and he exclaimed "Excellent" "Excellent."

sa: इन्द्रोऽप्येषां प्रणमते किं पुनर्मानवो भुवि। अवलिप्ते न जानीषे वृद्धानां न श्रुतं त्वया॥ ब्राह्मणा ह्यग्निसदृशा दहेयुः पृथिवीमपि।
en: Not to mention the men on earth, even Indra bows down to them. O proud one, do you not know or have you not heard from old men that really the Brahmanas are like fire and even can burn the wheel earth.

sa: ततस्ततस्तु सर्वेषां भूमिपानां महात्मनाम्॥ तिस्रोऽन्याः समवर्तन्त वाहिन्यो भरतर्षभ।
en: O you foremost among the race of Bharata, from the large minded kings of other countries, there came three other armies.

sa: अधर्मरुचयो मूढास्तिर्यग्गतिपरायणाः। कृच्छ्रां योनिमनुप्राप्ता न सुखं विन्दते जनाः॥
en: Foolish persons, addicted to vice and bestial ways, obtain the birth of beasts in after life and they never enjoy happiness.

sa: भुक्त्वा चान्नं ततः सर्वमुच्छिष्टेनात्मनस्ततः। अथाङ्गं लिलिपेऽनेन यथागतमगाच्च सः॥
en: Having eaten up all that food, he besmeared his body with the uncleaned remainder and went away as he had come.

sa: क्षुधितोऽस्मि ददस्वान्नं शीघ्रं मम नराधिप॥ इत्युक्त्वा गच्छति स्नातुं प्रत्यागच्छति वै चिरात्। न भोक्ष्याम्यद्य मे नास्ति क्षुधेत्युक्त्वैत्यदर्शनम्॥
en: Sometime saying “O ruler of men I am hungry, give me food without delay," he would go to bathe but would return after along time and say, “I shall not eat anything today, I have no appetite." So saying he would disappear.

sa: ततस्त्रिगर्तः सधनुरवतीर्य महारथात्। गदया चतुरो वाहान् राज्ञस्तस्य तदावधीत्॥
en: Thereupon descending from his huge car Trigarta, with bow in hand, slew the four horses of the king with his mace.

sa: स विनद्य महानादं गजः किङ्किणभूषणः। पतन्नवाक्शिरा भूमौ हस्त्यारोहमपोथयत्॥
en: Then emitting a loud noise that elephant, clad with mail, fell headlong upon the ground crushing its riders by its fall.

sa: इदमत्यद्भुतं चात्र चकार पुरुषोऽर्जुनः। कोशमात्रगतानश्वान् सैन्धवस्य जघान यत्॥
en: The heroic Arjuna performed a wonderful fcat by killing the horses of Saindhava, which were at a distance of two miles.

sa: दासोऽस्मीति तथा वाच्यं संसत्सु च सभासु च) एवं ते जीवितं दद्यामेष युद्धजितो विधिः॥
en: In public meetings and open courts you should always say that you are our slave; (if you can make this condition) I can give you your life. This is the custom of the victorious."

sa: ततः स राजा मतिमान् मत्वाऽऽत्मानं वयोऽधिकम्। मन्त्रयामास सचिवैधर्मज्ञैश्च पुरोहितैः॥ अभिषेकाय रामस्य यौवराज्येन भारत।
en: O Bharata, then that wise monarch considering himself far too advanced in age (to look after worldly affairs), for the installation of Rama as the prince regent; consulted with his righteous ministers and priests.

sa: तस्य तत् सर्वमाचख्यौ भगिनी रामविक्रमम्। खरदूषणसंयुक्तं राक्षसानां पराभवम्॥
en: Then his sister informed him of the prowess of Rama causing the defeat of the Rakshasas led by Khara and Dushana.

sa: प्राकारवप्रसम्बाधां निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा। प्रविवेश पुरी लङ्कां ससीतो राक्षसेश्वरः॥
en: Surrounded by high ramparts and built by Vishvakarma. And then the lord of the Rakshasas entered his city, Lanka, with Sita.

sa: एषा पम्पा शिवजला हंसकारण्डवायुता। ऋष्यमूकस्य शैलस्य संनिकर्षे तटाकिनी॥
en: In the vicinity of the (mountain) Rishyamukha there is a lake named Pampa of auspicious waters, teeming with swans and crames.

sa: उभौ रुधिरसंसिक्तौ नखदन्तपरिक्षतौ। शुशुभाते तदा वीरौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: Both those warriors torn with each others) nails and teeth were besmeared with blood and shone like two blooming Kinshuka flowers.

sa: क्षिप्रमेष्यति ते भर्ता सुग्रीवेणाभिरक्षितः। सौमित्रिसहितो धीमांस्त्वां चेतो मोक्षयिष्यति॥
en: Your intelligent husband accompanied by the son of Sumitra and protected by Sugriva will soon arrive (here) and deliver you hence.

sa: मध्ये राक्षसकोटीनां बह्वीनां सुमहाबलः। शुशुभे मेघमालाभिरादित्य इव संवृतः॥
en: And that highly-powerful one surrounded by innumerable crores of Rakshasas shone like the sun in the midst of masses of clouds.

sa: शस्त्रवर्षाणि वर्षन्तो द्रावयित्वा वनौकसः। प्राकारं शोभयन्तस्ते परं विक्रममास्थिताः॥
en: Discharging a (perfect) deluge of arrows and displaying great prowess, they graced the walls on driving away the dwellers of forests.

sa: सोऽभिपत्य महावेगं रुक्मपुङ्ख महाशरम्॥ प्राहिणोत् कुम्भकर्णाय लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा।
en: And coming up, that slayer of hostile warriors, Lakshmana, sent after him an impetuous and mighty dart furnished with golden wings.

sa: तस्याभिपततस्तूर्णं क्षुराभ्यामुच्छ्रितौ करौ। चिच्छेद निशिताचाभ्यां स बभूव चतुर्भुजः॥
en: When he was (thus) advancing, (Lakshmana) quickly cut off his upraised arms with a pair keen-edged razors. He then became four-handed.

sa: तानप्यस्य भुजान् सर्वान् प्रगृहीतशिलायुधान्। क्षुचिच्छेद लघ्वस्त्रं सौमित्रिः प्रतिदर्शयन्॥
en: (But) the son of Sumitra, displaying his skill in arms cut off all those arms, holding stones as arrows, by razors.

sa: रामलक्ष्मणसुग्रीवाः शरस्पर्श न तेऽनघ। समर्थाः प्रतिसोढुं च कुतस्तदनुयायिनः॥
en: O sinless one, not to speak of their followers, even Rama, Lakshmana and Sugriva cannot endure the touch of your weapons.

sa: सोऽङ्गदेन रुषोत्सृष्टो वधायेन्द्रजितस्तरुः॥ जघानेन्द्रजितः पार्थ रथं साश्वं ससारथिम्।
en: And that tree, hurled wrathfully by Angada for killing Indrajita, O Partha, destroyed his car together with the charioteer and horses.

sa: यम उवाच मनोऽनुकूलं बुधबुद्धिवर्धनं त्वया यदुक्तं वचनं हिताश्रयम्। विना पुनः सत्यवतोऽस्य जीवितं वरं द्वितीयं वरयस्व भामिनि॥
en: Yama said: The words spoken by you are pregnant with great import. They augment the wisdom of even the learned and are delightful to the mind. Therefore, O damsel, with the exception of Satyavana's life to you ask for a second boon.

sa: ततो हर्म्यतलस्था सा महार्हशयनोचिता। प्राच्यां दिशि समुद्यन्तं ददर्शादित्यमण्डलम्॥
en: And as she was seated on a costly bed in her room she beheld the sun's disc rising in the east.

sa: प्राणानुपस्पृश्य तदा ह्याजुहाव दिवाकरम्। आजगाम ततो राजंस्त्वरमाणो दिवाकरः॥
en: Having gone through Pranayam, she invoked the author of the day. And, O king, the sun too speedily appeared before her.

sa: स तामुद्धृत्य मञ्जूषामुत्सार्य जलमन्तिकात्। यन्त्रैरुद्धाटयामास सोऽपश्यत् तत्र बालकम्॥
en: He (Adhiratha) then carried the basket from the water-side and had it opened by instruments. And therein he teheld a boy.

sa: यक्ष उवाच किंस्विद् गुरुतरं भूमेः किस्विदुच्चतरं च खात्। किंस्विच्छीघ्रतरं वायोः किंस्विद् बहुतरं तृणात्॥
en: The Yaksha said : What thing is weightier than the earth? What is it that is higher than the sky? What is fleeter than the wind? And what is more numerous than the grass?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्त्रयोधर्मः सदाफलः। मनो यम्य न शोचन्ति संधिः सद्भिर्न जीर्यते॥
en: Yudhishthira said: Absence of cruelty is the highest virtue. The religion of the three (Vedas) always bears fruit. The mind, if subdued, does not lead to misery and friendship with the righteous never breaks.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं विराटनगरे मम पूर्वपितामहाः। अज्ञातवासमुषिता दुर्योधनभयार्दिताः॥
en: Janamejaya said How did my great grand fathers, stricken with the fear of Duryodhana, live incognito in the city of Virata?

sa: अग्नीन् प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य ब्राह्मणांश्च तपोधनान्। याज्ञसेनी पुरस्कृत्य षडेवाथ प्रवव्रजुः॥
en: Then the six, having circumbulated the fire and the Brahmanas whose only treasure is austerity, departed with Yajnseni ahead of them.

sa: त्राहि मां पद्मपत्राक्षि सत्ये सत्या भवस्व नः॥ शरणं भव मे दुर्गे शरण्ये भक्तवत्सले।
en: O possessor of eyes like the petals of lotuses, be truth to us who are seeking after truth. O Durga, O refuge of all, O affectionate to devotees, be pleased to grant me protection.

sa: विराट उवाच त्वं ब्राह्मणो यदि वा क्षत्रियोऽसि समुद्रनेमीश्वररूपवानसि। आचक्ष्व मे तत्त्वममित्रकर्शन न वैश्यकर्म त्वयि विद्यते क्षमम्॥
en: Virata said You must either be a Brahmana or a Kshatriya, you are as graceful as the lord of the entire earth girt by the sea. Tell me truly, O afflicter of enemies, the offlice of a Vaishya does not become you.

sa: स वै हयानैक्षत तांस्ततस्ततः समीक्षमाणं स ददर्श मत्स्यराट्। ततोऽब्रवीत् ताननुगान् नरेश्वरः कुतोऽयमायाति नरोऽमरोपमः॥
en: He began to observe the horses around; the king of the Matsya's, the lord of people, seeing him observing his horses minutely asked his followers "whence is this man lustrous like a celestials, coming"?

sa: यस्माद् भयममित्राणां सदैव पुरुषर्षभात्। स लोकपरिभूतेन वेषेणास्ते धनंजयः॥
en: That Dhananjaya, from whom, the best of men, enemies had constant dread, is now living in a guise hated by all.

sa: ह्रीनिषेवो मधुरवाकधार्मिकश्च प्रियश्च मे। स तेऽरण्येषु वोढव्यो याज्ञसेनि क्षपास्वपि॥ सुकुमारश्च शूरच राजानं चाप्यनुव्रतः। ज्येष्ठापचायिनं वीरं स्वयं पाज्ञालि भोजये:।३९॥ इत्युवाच हि मां कुन्ती रुदती पुत्रगृद्धिनी। प्रव्रजन्तं महारण्यं तं परिष्वज्य तिष्ठती॥
en: Kunti, greatly attached to her sons, stood weeping with Sahadeva in her arms, while he was starting (with us) for the great forest and addressed me thus-"Sahadeva is bashful, sweet-voiced, virtuous, and very dear to me, therefore, Yajnaseni cheer him up while he feels dejected and tend him in the forest, day and night. He is tender and brave, devoted to the king, heroic and always respectful to his elder brother; O Panchali, feed him yourself."

sa: दोश्च सूतपुत्रोऽसौ गन्धर्वानवमन्यते। तं त्वं प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठ ह्रदानागमिवोद्धर॥
en: O Pandava, going to that dancing hall, take his life. From pride only, that son of a Suta slights the Gandharvas.

sa: देशे तस्मिन् भविष्यन्ति तात पाण्डवसंयुते। सम्प्रीतिमाढानस्तत्र संतुष्टः शुचिरव्ययः॥
en: O my child, in countries where the Pandavas will live, people will all be contented, cheerful, pure and of eternal virtue.

sa: योत्स्यसे चापि बलिभिररिभिः प्रत्युपस्थितैः। अन्यस्त्वं पाण्डवैर्वापि हीनैः स्वबलवाहनैः
en: You shall then be able to fight with the powerful enemies who will come-what of Pandavas, weak in soldiers and animals.

sa: असकृन्मत्स्यराज्ञा मे राष्ट्र बाधितमोजसा। प्रणेता कीचकस्तस्य बलवानभवत् पुरा॥
en: My kingdom has been again and again forcibly invaded by the king of Matsya's. Formerly the mighty Kichaka was his general.

sa: जनाः समवबुध्येरन् भीमोऽयमिति भारत। अन्यदेवायुधं किंचित् प्रतिपद्यस्व मानुषम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, people will then recognize you and say “This is Bhima". Take you therefore, some other human weapon,

sa: विराटं समवीक्ष्यैनं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चावदत्॥ सुशर्मा चिन्तयामास कालान्तकयमोपमम्।
en: Casting his looks on Virata he said to (Susharma) “stay stay.” Susharma thought him to be Yama-the very regent of death.

sa: अथैष कश्चिदेवान्यः क्लीबवेषेण मानवः। शरैरेनं सुनिशितैः पातयिष्यामि भूतले॥
en: If he be any one else in a eunuch's guise I shall soon place him on the ground with sharp arrows.

sa: सोऽपयात् सहसा पश्चात् साहसाच्चाभ्युपेयिवान्॥ शरवातैः सुतीक्ष्णाप्रैः समादिष्टैः खगेरिव।
en: He all on a sudden from behind attacked the army with a net of sharpened arrows like birds ordered (by fowlers).

sa: चकार गौतमः सज्यं तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ स तदप्यस्य कौन्तेयश्चिच्छेद नतपर्वणा।
en: Gautama made it ready. And it appeared wonderful. The son of Kunti cut off that too with arrows having depressed knots.

sa: तामर्जुनस्तदाऽऽयान्तीं शक्तिं हेमविभूषिताम्। वियद्गतां महोल्काभां चिच्छेद दशभिः शरैः॥
en: While that golden javelin came coursing through the sky, burning like a huge fire-brand Arjuna cut it off with ten arrows.

sa: व्यशातयच्छरांस्तांस्तु द्रोणः समितिशोभनः॥ महानभूत् ततः शब्दो वंशानामिव दह्यताम्॥
en: Then Drona, ornament of an assembly, discharged sharpened arrows. Then arose a sound like that of bamboo's when set on fire.

sa: दुष्करं कृतवान् द्रोणो यदर्जुनमयोधयत्॥ प्रमाथिनं महावीर्यं दृढमुष्टिं दुरासदम्।
en: Drona has performed a difficult feat for he fights with Arjuna, of great energy, firmhanded, irrepressible and an afflicter of foes.

sa: अथापरेण बाणेन ज्वलितेन महौजसा। विव्याध कर्णं कौन्तेयस्तीक्ष्णेनोरसि वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then taking up another strong, sharp, and powerful arrow, the powerful son of Kunti struck Karna with it on his breast.

sa: अथ सैन्यं महद् दृष्ट्वा रथनागहयाकुलम्। अब्रवीदुत्तरः पार्थमपविद्धः शरैर्भृशम्॥
en: Then beholding the huge army consisting of cars, elephants and iorses, and being wounded greatly with arrows Uttara said to Partha.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुः पृथुधारेण कार्मुकम्। चिच्छेद गार्धपत्रेण भीष्मस्यादित्यतेजसः॥
en: The smiling Bibhatsu with sharp shafts furnished with vulture feathers cut off the bow of Bhishma resembling the sun in effulgence.

sa: तान् प्रस्थितान् प्रीतमनाः स पार्थो धनंजयः प्रेक्ष्य कुरुप्रवीरान्। अभाषमाणोऽनुनयं मुहूर्त वचोब्रवीत् सम्परिहत्य भूयः॥
en: Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti filled with joy within heart when he saw Kaurava's army moving from there. He kept mum for more than half an hour without saying anything in request and submission.

sa: कङ्क उवाच किं ते द्यूतेन राजेन्द्र बहुदोषेण मानद। देवने बहवो दोषास्तस्मात् तत् परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: Kanka said "O king, O giver of honours, what have you to do with gambling which is attended with so many evils. There are many evils in gambling, and so you should avoid it.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा रोमहर्षोऽभूदूरुकम्बश्च मारिष। स तत्र सिंहसंकाशमनीकं व्यधमच्छरैः॥
en: Beholding it, my hairs stood erect and the thighs to treinble. But he struck with his arrows that army of lions.

sa: एनमष्टशताः सूताः सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डलाः। अब्रुवन् मागधैः सार्धं पुरा शक्रमिवर्षयः॥
en: As all sages chant pray lord Indra, he was carlier prayed by eight hundred soothsayers and Magadha (clown) bearing gem-studded car-rings.

sa: एतेषां बाहुवीर्येण अस्माकं विजयो मृधे। एवं सर्वे सहामात्याः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। प्रसादयामो भद्रं ते सानुजं पाण्डवर्षभम्॥ यदस्माभिरजानद्धिः किंचिदुक्तो नराधिपः। क्षन्तुमर्हति तत् सर्वं धर्मात्मा ह्येष पाण्डवः॥
en: By their prowess, we have won victory in battle. Along with our ministers, we shall propitiate the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, the foremost of Pandavas, together with his younger brothers. (He then said to him): "May good betide you. O king, If I we have unwittingly given you any offence, you should forgive me for all that. The son of Pandu is virtuous-souled.

sa: त्वामग्ने जलदानाहुर्विद्युतश्च मनीषिणः। दहन्ति सर्वभूतानि त्वत्तो निष्क्रम्य हेतयः॥
en: Wise people called you, O Agni, the giver of water and lightning and flames coming out from you support all beings.

sa: तदप्यनुमतं कर्म यथायुक्तमनेन वै। वासिताश्च महारण्ये वर्षाणीह त्रयोदश॥
en: Even this act, undesirable as it was, approved of by him and they lived for thirteen years in the great forest.

sa: ते चेत् कुरूननुशिष्याथ पार्था निर्णीय सर्वान् द्विषतो निगृह्य। समं वस्तज्जीवितं मृत्युना स्याद् यज्जीवध्वं ज्ञातिवधे न साधु॥
en: If after subjugating the Kurus, O you sons of Pritha and defeating all, you destroy those who despise you, then the succeeding portion of your life will be equal to death, since what is life after killing all your all your cousins?

sa: अथ संत्यजतो धर्ममधर्मं चानुतिष्ठतः। प्रतिसंवेष्टते भूमिरग्नौ चर्माहितं यथा।॥
en: Again, the territories, that of king who leaving virtue practices unrighteousness, contract like a piece of leather thrown into the fire.

sa: आर्जवेन नरं युक्तमार्जवात् सव्यपत्रपम्। अशक्तं मन्यमानास्तु धर्षयन्ति कुबुद्धयः॥
en: Persons of bad intelligence oppress people endued with humility and modesty by reason of that humility, thinking them to be weak.

sa: पूर्वरूपमिदं पश्य वयं जेष्याम संजय। बीभत्सुर्मा यथोवाच तथावैम्यहमप्युत॥
en: See these signs of prophecy; we will conquer, O Sanjaya, what Vibhatsu told me. I also saw the truth of this.

sa: तावन्तरिक्षगौ शीघ्रमनुयान्तं महीचरम्। श्लोकेनानेन कौरव्य पप्रच्छ स मुनिस्तदा॥
en: Then did the anchoring address, O Kauravya, that denizen of the earth following the wanderers of the sky in this couplet.

sa: न तथा बाध्यते कृष्ण प्रकृत्या निर्धनो जनः। यथा भद्रां श्रियं प्राप्य हीनः सुखैधितः॥
en: A man without wealth from his very birth does not suffer so much, 0 Krishna, as one who after the possession of great prosperity and a life of great happiness is deprived of it.

sa: तत्रासन् समानीतास्ते दृष्ट्वा त्वामनागसम्। अश्रुकण्ठा रुदन्तश्च सभायामासते तदा॥
en: Those who were assembled there, seeing you without any fault at the time sat in the council weeping with choked voices.

sa: उद्वेपते ते हृदयं मनस्ते प्रतिसीदति। ऊरुस्तम्भगृहीतोऽसि तस्मात् प्रशममिच्छसि॥
en: Your heart shakes with fear; your mind is filled with despair; and your thighs tremble; and therefore do you desire peace.

sa: अथवा मन्यसे ज्यायान् वधस्तेषामनन्तरम्। तदेव क्रियतामाशु न विचार्यमतस्त्वया॥
en: If you consider their immediate destruction better, do that instantly for there is nothing to be considered about in this matter.

sa: सस्त्रीपुरुषबालं च नगरं मधुसूदनम्। उदीक्षतां महात्मानं भानुमन्तमिव प्रजाः॥
en: Let my subjects in this town, including women, men and children, behold the largesouled slayer of Madhu like the rising sun.

sa: आशंसमानः कल्याणं कुरूनभ्येति केशवः। येनैव राजन्नर्थेन तदेवास्मा उपाकुरु॥
en: Keshava comes here expecting to do good to the Kurus. Do that, О king, by which that object may be gained.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथोपगम्य विदुरमपराह्ने जनार्दनः। पितृष्वसारं स पृथामभ्यगच्छदरिंदमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said After his visit to Vidura, Janardana, the subduer of enemies, went in the afternoon to Pritha, his mother's sister.

sa: विदितौ हि तवात्यन्तं क्रुद्धौ तौ तु यथान्तकौ। भीमार्जुनौ नयेतां हि देवानपि परां गतिम्॥
en: And (when such is the case) Bhima and Arjuna can bring the very gods to the end of their life. This insult, namely that Krishna was dragged to the Assembly-Hall was offered to them;

sa: न्यमन्त्रयद् भोजनेन नाभ्यनन्दच्च केशवः। ततो दुर्योधनः कृष्णमब्रवीत् कुरुसंसदि॥
en: Invited to dinner; but Keshava did not accept the invitation; then Duryodhana said to Krishna in that assembly of the Kurus.

sa: ततः सा समितिः सर्वा राज्ञाममिततेजसाम्। सम्प्राकम्पत हर्षेण कृष्णागमनकाझया॥
en: The entire assembly of those kings of immeasurable energy began to shake with delight with the desire of seeing Krishna come.

sa: पुत्रास्तव कौरव्य दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः। धर्मार्थौ पृष्ठतः कृत्वा प्रचरन्ति नृशंसवत्॥
en: Those sons of yours, O Kaurava, headed by Duryodhana, are acting impiously setting aside all considerations of morality and earthly good.

sa: अन्नं तेन तदा भुक्तमन्यैर्दत्तं तपस्विभिः। अथ गृह्यान्नमत्युष्णं विश्वामित्रोऽप्युपागमत्॥
en: When he had taken the fool offered by other devotees, Vishvamitra too came there taking his food which was very hot.

sa: एषा दिक् सा द्विजश्रेष्ठ यां सर्वः प्रतिपद्यते। वृता त्वनवबोधेन सुखं तेन न गम्यते॥
en: This is that direction, O foremost among the twice born, where every body must go; and as all of them are surrounded by the darkness of ignorance they cannot come here with perfect happiness.

sa: अत्र राक्षसराजेन पौलस्त्येन महात्मना। रावणेन तपश्चीक़ सुरेभ्योऽमरता वृता॥
en: Here by the great-souled son of Pulastya Ravana, the king of Rakshasas who practiced austerities, was solicited immortality of the gods.

sa: अत्र काञ्चनशैलस्य काञ्चनाम्बुरुहस्य च। उदधेस्तीरमासाद्य सुरभिः क्षरते पयः॥
en: In this direction coming to the shore of the sea having golden mountains and golden lotuses, does Suravi yield her milk.

sa: बहुवर्षसहस्राख्ये काले बहुगुणे गते। राजर्षिषु निषण्णेषु महीयस्सु महर्धिषु॥
en: After many thousands of years had elapsed in great happiness and while seated among royal Rishis of great luster and renown.

sa: रत्नौषधिसमेतेन रक्ताङ्गुलितलेन च। उपविष्टस्य पृष्ठं ते पाणिना परिमार्जतु॥
en: Let him put his hands with fingers bedecked with gems and the palm red, on your back while you are seated.

sa: एकार्णवे च स्वफता निहतौ मधुकैटभौ। जन्मान्तरमुपागम्य हयग्रीवस्तथा हतः॥
en: White lying asleep on the all spreading ocean by were Madhu and Kaitabha slain and in another birth was Hayagriva slain.

sa: राज्ये स्थितो धृतराष्ट्रो मनीषी तस्यानुजो विदुरो दीर्घदर्शी। एतावतिक्रम्य कथं नृपत्वं दुर्योधन प्रार्थयसेऽद्य मोहात्॥
en: The wise Dhritarashtra is now established on the throne and under him as a subordinate is Vidura of great foresight; superseding these two how can you, O Duryodhana, desire the kingdom out of folly?

sa: हृष्टास्तुष्टाः कवचिन: सशस्त्राः समलंकृताः। राजानमन्ययुः सर्वे परिवार्य युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: With cheerful hearts, clad in coats of mail, well-armed, and with their persons well ornamented, all followed surrounding the king Yudhishthira.

sa: अहं चैव क्षणेनैव निर्मनुष्यमिदं जगत्। कुर्यां शस्त्रबलेनैव ससुरासुरराक्षसम्॥
en: I, in a moment, shall make this world destitute of men, gods, Asuras and Rakshasas by the strength of my weapons.

sa: सैनापत्ये यदा राजा गाङ्गेयमभिषिक्तवान्। तदैतान्युग्ररूपाणि बभूवुः शतशो नृप।॥
en: When the king installed the son of Ganga in the generalship these frightful sights appeared in hundreds, O ruler of men.

sa: राघवस्य हरीणां च कथमासीत्समागमः। कस्मिन्देशे किमाश्रित्य तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः॥
en: Do you relate truly to me, how and in what country the union between Rāghava and the monkeys was brought about.

sa: तमापतन्तं दृष्ट्वा स रथादाप्लुत्य वीर्यवान्। गदापाणिरसंभ्रान्तः पृथिव्यां समतिष्ठत॥
en: Seeing this descend upon him, that powerful one, calmly leaping down from his vehicle, stood on his feet on the ground.

sa: विद्युत्केशो हेतिपुत्रः स दीप्तार्कसमप्रभः। व्यवर्धत महातेजास्तोयमध्य इवाम्बुजम् ॥
en: Heti's son, the exceedingly energetic Vidyutkeśa, possessed of the splendour of the sun, grew up even like a lotus in water.

sa: महतापि महाबाहुः प्रत्ययेन महाबलः॥ प्रहितो रावणेनैष सह वीरैर्मदोद्धतैः।
en: That hero of great prowess and mighty-arms with a number of other proud heroes was despatched by Rāvana in great confidence.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महातेजा नष्टशोकोऽभवत्तदा। धारयामास सुप्रीतो राघवः प्रयतात्मवान् ॥ आदित्यं प्रेक्ष्य जप्त्वेदं परं हर्षमवाप्तवान्। त्रिराजम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्॥ रावणं प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा जयार्थं समुपागमत्। सर्वयत्नेन महता वृतस्तस्य वधेऽभवत्॥
en: Hearing this that exceedingly energetic one had his grief gone. then, well pleased, Raghava, exerting himself, contemplated (the hymn). And reciting this he beholding the Sun, attained excess of Joy. And sipping water again and again, and becoming purified, that powerful one, taking up his bow, and viewing Rāvana, advanced with a delighted heart, to obtain victory. And he became intent on his death with his dearest energies.

sa: दीर्घमुष्णं विनिःश्वस्य क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः। अब्रवीद्राक्षसं क्रूरं वज्रदंष्ट्र महाबलम्॥
en: And collide with passion, and sighing hot for a long time, he addressed a cruel Rākşasa-the exceedingly strong Vajradanșrta. *Lit-the thunder-toothed.

sa: अनुवालिसुतस्यापि बलेन महता वृतः। वीरस्तिष्ठति संग्रामे सेतुहेतुरयं नलः॥
en: Following Väli's son, and surrounded by a mighty force, stay in the field the heroic Nala, the builder of the bridge.

sa: हतः सः निपपाताथ धरण्यां रावणात्मजः। कवची सशिरस्त्राणो विप्रविद्धशरासनः॥
en: And slain, Ravana's son dropped to the earth, with his armour and corslet on, and his bow fallen (from his grasp).

sa: ततोऽवर्धत मे कायस्तदा पर्वतसंनिभः। युद्धाकाङ्क्षी वनं तस्य विनाशयितुमारभे॥
en: Thereupon my body increased like to a mountain and desirous of entering into conflict I began to lay waste the forest.

sa: अन्योन्यं लम्बितकरौ ततस्तौ हरिराक्षसौ। किष्किन्धां विशतुर्हष्टौ सिंहौ गिरिगुहामिव॥
en: Thereupon holding each other by the arms they entered the city of Kiskindha like to two lions, entering delightedly a cave.

sa: विराटनगरे तात संवत्सरमिमं वयम्। कुर्वन्तस्तस्य कर्माणि विहरिष्याम भारत॥
en: In the city of Virata, O dear one, we shall, O Bharata, spend the whole of his year, doing his work.

sa: संदधानो हि कालेन विगृह्णश्चारिभिः सह। स्वपक्षे वर्धनं कुर्वन्महदैश्वर्यमश्नुते॥
en: He that seasonably concludes peace and carries on war with his enemies, and who advances his own party, attain great affluence.

sa: भिन्नाञ्जनचयश्यामो विस्फार्य विपुलं धनुः। भूय एव शरान्धोरान्विससर्ज महामृधे॥
en: And stretching his large bow, that one sable like to a mass of crushed collyrium again discharged terrific shafts in battle.

sa: रामस्य धनुषः शब्दं श्रोष्यसि त्वं महास्वनम्। शतक्रतुविसृष्टस्य निर्घोषमशनेरिव॥ इह शीघ्रं सुपर्वाणो ज्वलितास्या इवोरगाः। इषवो निपतिष्यन्ति रामलक्ष्मणलक्षिताः॥
en: You shall hear the terrible sound of the twang of Rāma's bow, like to the sound of the thunderbolt hurled by Indra. Soon shall arrows, bearing the names of Rāma and Lakşmaņa and having fiery heads like those of snakes, alight here.

sa: एवं लालप्यमानायां सीतायां तत्र राक्षसः। अभिचक्राम भर्तारमनीकस्थः कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: As the Rāksasa was by while Sītā was thus bewailing, there appeared before his lord, with joined hands, the warder, saying.

sa: काञ्चनैश्चैव भृङ्गारैर्जहुः सलिलमग्रतः। मण्डलाग्रा बृसीश्चैव गृह्यान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः॥
en: Some carrying water in golden jars headed the train while others carrying the golden throne covered with a coverlet followed it.

sa: सशल्यः स समाघ्राय लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। विशल्यो विरुनः शीघ्रमुदतिष्ठन्महीतलात्॥
en: Thereupon the wounded Lakşmana, slayer of hostile heroes-smelling it, curd of his wound and ailments, speedily rose up from the ground.

sa: तस्य रूपं शरस्यासीत्सधूमज्वालमण्डलम्। वनं दहिष्यतो धर्मे दावाग्नेरिव मूर्च्छतः॥
en: And the appearance of the shaft was like an extinguishing fire in summer with smoke with flames, burning up a forest.

sa: राक्षसैः स्तूयमानः सञ्जयाशीभिररिंदमः॥ आससाद महातेजाः सभां विरचितां तदा।
en: Hymned by the Råkşasas with blessings of victory, that exceedingly energetic chastiser of enemies arrived at the court constructed (by Viśvakarmā).

sa: याते तस्मिन्दशग्रीवे राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। सीतां निर्भर्त्सयामासुर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैः सुदारुणैः॥
en: On the Ten-necked one having departed, the Rákşasis of fearful faces fell to railing at Sītā in cruel and rough words.

sa: त्रिभिः किरीटैलिशिराः शुशुभे स रथोत्तमे। हिमवानिव शैलेन्द्रखिभिः काञ्चनपर्वतैः॥
en: Dight with three diadems, Trisiras looked splendid in that superb car, like the monarch of mountains Himavān—with the three golden hills.

sa: सर्वथा तु महत्कर्म करिष्यति बलोत्कटः। राक्षसः पुत्रसहितो दृष्टमेतन्निसर्गतः॥
en: Irrepressible by virtue of his prowess, that Raksasa, with his son, shall accomplish a mighty object. It seems to be real.

sa: सुषेण: पश्चिमद्वारं गत्वा तारापिता बली। आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ कटिकोटिभिरावृतः॥
en: The strong sire of Tārā the powerful Sus ena, obstructed the Western gate, backed by kot is upon kotis (of monkeys).

sa: वानराणां च नादेन संरब्धो रावणस्तदा। संभ्रमाविष्टहृदयो न किंचित्प्रत्यपद्यत।॥
en: Rāvana enraged at the shouts of the monkeys, with his heart overwhelmed with agitation, could not address himself to any affort.

sa: ततो रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गं प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतम्। रावणं राक्षसा दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं समुपागमन्॥
en: Then seeing Rāvaņa, with his person bathed in blood, bettered by the weapon discharged at him, they were seized with surprise.

sa: मित्रकार्य कृतमिदं भवद्भिनिरर्षभाः। अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टं प्रतिगच्छत॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, you have performed a friendly service-it has been appreciated by medo you repair to your wished-for quarters.

sa: प्रचुक्रुशुः स्त्रियः सर्वास्तां दृष्ट्वा हव्यवाहने। पतन्तीं संस्कृतां मन्त्रैर्वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे॥
en: Beholding her fallen into the fire like to Vasudhārā, sanctified by Mantras in a sacrifice, all the females began to weep.

sa: तं समुत्थाय काकुत्स्थश्चिरस्याक्षिपथं गतम्। अङ्के भरतमारोप्य मुदितः परिषस्वजे॥
en: Raising Bharata up who had been seen after a long time and placing him on his lap Kākutstha, delighted, embraced him.

sa: यदि ह्यस्मिन्निपतिते न म्रियेतैष राक्षसः। प्रियते वा दशग्रीवस्तदाप्युभयतोऽनृतम्॥
en: Whether on this weapon alighting, the tennecked does not die, or if he does do either way falsehood is the consequence.

sa: अद्य वो मामका बाणा महाकार्मुकनिःसृताः। विधमिष्यन्ति गात्राणि तूलराशिमिवानलः॥
en: fo-day my shafts discharged from my mighty bow shall mangle your limbs, even as fire burn up a heap of cotton.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः संहृष्टो निर्जगाम महाबलः। राज्ञस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा योद्धमुद्युक्तवांस्तदा॥
en: Having been thus accosted, that highly powerful one, went out cheerfully. And hearing the king's speech, he made ready for fight.

sa: अथाश्वस्य महातेजाः कृच्छ्राद्देवान्तको बली॥ आविध्य परिघं वेगादाजधान तदाङ्गदम्।
en: Then cheering him, the exceedingly energetic and powerful Narāntaka, violently whirling his bludgeon with might and main, hit Angada with it.

sa: समाप्तकर्मा हि स राक्षसर्षभो भवत्यदृश्यः समरे सुरासुरैः। युयुत्सता तेन समाप्तकर्मणा भवेत्सुराणामपि संशयो महान्॥
en: If that foremost of Räkşasas can finish his rites, he shall be invisible to both celestials and Asuras; and, he fighting after finishing his sacrifice, the celestials themselves shall be placed in great jeopardy.

sa: स वेगवान्महावेगं कृत्वा परमदुर्जयः। तलेन समभिदुत्य जघानास्य महागजम्॥
en: That impetuous one incapable of being conquered, summoning his utmost vehemence, rushing on, pealt a slap at his* mighty elephant. *Mahodara's.

sa: दृष्ट्वा प्राप्तान्मुनींस्तांस्तु प्रत्युत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः। पाद्याादिभिरान गां निवेद्य च सादरम्॥ रामोऽभिवाद्य प्रयत आसनान्यादिदेश ह।
en: Seeing the ascetics him, Rāma with joined hands worshipped their feet with arghyas, and with regard consecrated a cow to each, and saluting them with the collecting mind, he ordered seats (for the saints).

sa: तथा विप्रेक्षमाणस्य वनं पुष्पितपादपम्। विचिन्वतश्च वैदेही किंचिच्छेषा निशाऽभवत्॥
en: Beholding the forest filled with flowery trees and desiring to have a full view of her, he, wellnigh, spent the night.

sa: तत्कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सायाह्ने शरभङ्गस्य रम्यमाश्रममीयतुः॥
en: Having accomplished that difficult work the two brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa, arrived in the evening at the pleasant hermitage of Sarabhanga.

sa: हताश्वात्तु तदा वेगादवप्लुत्य महारथात्। कोपमाहारयत्तीवं भ्रातरं प्रति रावणः॥
en: Thereat leaping down from his mighty car, whose horses had been slain, Råvana was fired with high wrath against his brother.

sa: यथा मधुकरस्तर्षात्काशपुष्पं पिबन्नपि। रसमत्रन न विन्देत तथानार्येषु सैहृदम्॥
en: As a bee, after feeding uport the Kāśa flowers, does not get honey so is (fruitless) the friendship with unworthy persons.

sa: ततः कदाचित्किष्किन्धां नगरी वालिपालिताम्। गत्वाह्वयति युद्धाय वालिनं हेममालिनम्॥
en: After some time he arrived at the city of Kişkindhā reared by Vāli and invited him, wearing golden garland, to fight.

sa: मातंग इव सिंहेन गरुडेनेव पन्नगः। अभिमूतोऽभवद्राजा राघवेण महात्मना॥
en: Overpowered by the high souled Rāghava, the king resembled an elephant defeated by a lion or a serpent defeated by Garuda.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही राक्षसीभिर्मनस्विनी। उवाच परमवस्ता वाष्यगद्गदया गिरा॥
en: And being thus addressed by those Rākşasīs, Vaidehi, of subdued soul, being greatly terrified, said, having her voice choked with vapour.

sa: अनुक्त्वा परुषं वाक्यं किंचिदप्यनवक्षिपन्। अविकत्थन्वधिष्यामि त्वां पश्य पुरुषादन॥
en: Mark! without speaking anything harsh, without censuring you in the least, without venting any brag, shall, I, O cannibal, slay you.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः। दीप्ताभ्यामिव दीपाभ्यां सार्चिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः॥
en: As fall drops of lighted oil from a flaming lamp, fell drops of tears from the eyes of the enraged Ravana.

sa: अकृतात्मानमासाद्य राजानमनये रतम्। समृद्धानि विनश्यन्ति राष्ट्राणि नगराणि च॥
en: Wealth, kingdom and cities-all are brought to naught when they are placed at the hands of a vicious and illiterate king.

sa: ते नगाग्रान्नगाग्राणि शिखराच्छिखराणि च। प्रहृष्टाः समपद्यन्त हनूमन्तं दिक्षवः॥
en: And they, eager to have a sight of Hanumān, joyfully went from mountain-top to mountaintop and from peak on to peak.

sa: रावणस्तु ततः स्वस्थः शरवर्षं मुमोच ह। तस्मिन्वैवस्वतरथे तोयवर्षमिवाम्बुदः॥
en: But Rāvana, without at all feeling any smart, began to shower arrows on Vaivasvata's vehicle, resembling a downpour caused by clouds.

sa: समुद्रस्य ततः क्रुद्धो रामो रक्तान्तलोचनः। समीपस्थमुवाचेदं लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्॥
en: Thereat Răma grew enraged and had the corners of his eyes crimsoned; and he spank to Laksmana of auspicious marks, saying.

sa: यत्तदा दण्डकारण्ये पितरं हतवान्मम। तदग्रतः स्वकर्मस्थं स्मृत्वा रोषोऽभिवर्धते॥
en: You did slay my father in the forest of Dandaka. Remembering your action and finding you before, my ire is excited.

sa: प्रचुक्रुशुः स्त्रियः सर्वास्तां दृष्ट्वा हव्यवाहने। पतन्तीं संस्कृतां मन्त्रैर्वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे॥
en: Beholding her fallen into the fire like to Vasudhārā, sanctified by Mantras in a sacrifice, all the females began to weep.

sa: विशल्योऽयं महाप्राज्ञः सौमित्रिमित्रवत्सलः। यथा भवति सुस्वस्थस्तथा त्वं समुदाचर॥
en: Do you so act that this highly wise son of Sumitrā, devoted to his friends, may be healed and be eased.

sa: नाघातयत्तदा रामः श्रुत्वा तत्परिदेवितम्। वानरानब्रवीद्रामो मुच्यतां दूत आगतः॥
en: Hearing this pitiful cry, Rāma prevented (the monkeys); and he said to them, Let go this envoy, who has come here.

sa: स विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दुर्धर्षं चैव राक्षसम्। प्रघसं भासकर्णं च पञ्चसेनाग्रनायकान्॥ संदिदेश दशग्रीवो वीरान् नयविशारदान्। हनूमद्ग्रहणे व्यग्रान्वायुवेगसमान्युधि ॥
en: He directed five of the foremost leaders of his forces, the heroic Virūpaksa Yupakşa, the Rāks asa Durdharsa, Praghasa, and Bhasakarma, versed in polity, endowed with the speed of the Wind in conflict and alert on every occasion, to take Hanumān captive.

sa: निपेतुः केचिदपरे केचिन्नैवावतस्थिरे। केचिद्भूमौ निपतिताः केचित्सुप्ता मृता इव॥
en: Others dropped down; and some ran on. And some fell down to the earth, and some lay insensible as if dead.

sa: इमे हि हरयः शूराः समरे कामरूपिणः। तानरीन्विधमिष्यन्ति शिलापादपवृष्टिभिः॥
en: These monkeys, heroic and capable of assuming in fight forms at will, shall slaughter those foes by showering rocks and trees.

sa: त्वं सर्वगुणसंपन्ना नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशम्। त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी भीरु यौवनं तेऽतिवर्तते॥
en: You, furnished with every perfection, should not talk thus. You are the paragon in these three worlds,. Your youth wax away.

sa: तमुग्रवेगं संरब्धमापतन्तं महाकपिः॥ ततः संप्रेक्ष्य जग्राह महावेगो महाशिलाम्।
en: Witnessing that enraged (hero) rushing against him with exceeding impetuosity, that redoubted monkey endowed with vehemence, took up a tremendous crag.

sa: दानवेन्द्रो महाबाहो वीर्योत्सिक्तो दुरासदः। विगृह्य वशमानीतः कुम्भीनस्याः सुखावहः॥
en: O you of mighty arms, you did bring under your subjection the powerful and irrepressible Dänava for the pleasure of Kumbhīnasī.

sa: एवमुक्तः स चैतेन ब्रह्मणा वानरोत्तमः। प्रणम्य शिरसा पादौ देवदेवस्य राघव॥ उक्तवाँल्लोककर्तारमादिदेवं जगत्पतिम्। यथाज्ञापयसे देव स्थितोऽहं तव शासने॥ एवमुक्त्वा हरिदेवं ययौ हृष्टमनास्तदा। स तदा दुमखण्डेषु फलपुष्पधनेषु च॥
en: Brahmā having thus said this, O Raghava, the foremost of monkeys saluted that god of gods, placing his head at his feet and said to that Primeval deity, the creator of beings and the lord of the universe. "O god, you are placing me under your behests-verily I shall follow them." Having said this to Patriarch that monkey immediately went to a forest abounding in fruits and flowers.

sa: अहं विष्णुरहं रुद्रो ब्रह्माहं देवराडहम्। अहं यमश्च वरुणश्चन्द्रोऽहं रविरप्यहम्॥ इति माली सुमाली च माल्यवांश्चैव राक्षसाः। बाधन्ते समरोद्धर्षा ये च तेषां पुरःसराः॥
en: 'I am Vişnu,' 'I am Rudra,' 'I am the king of the celestials,' 'I am Yama,' 'I an Varuna,' 'I am the moon,' 'I am the Sun,' flattering themselves in this fashion, Māli and Sumāli and the Rākşasa Malyavān as well as those going before them, are annoying (the gods), breathing exhilaration of martial spirits.

sa: समरे जितमात्मानं प्रहस्तं च निषूदितम्॥ ज्ञात्वा रक्षो भीमबलमादिदेश महाबलः। द्वारेषु यत्नः क्रियतां प्राकारश्चाधिरुह्यताम्॥ निद्रावशसमाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम्।
en: Seeing himself worsted and Prahasta also slain, that Rākşasa endowed with dreadful power issued his orders to the fearful force. “Do you vigilantly guard the gates and mount the wall. And do you wake up Kumbhakarņa come under the sway of slumber.

sa: पितामहसुतश्चापि पुलस्त्यो मुनिपुङ्गवः। मोचयित्वा दशग्रीवं ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम ह॥
en: And having set Daśagriva at liberty Pulastya, the son of Brahma and the foremost of Munis repaired to the celestial region.

sa: स शङ्खशशिवर्णेन छत्रेण रिपुसूदनः। रराज प्रतिपूर्णेन नभश्चन्द्रमसा यथा॥
en: And with an umbrella hued like the Moon, that destroyer of enemies appeared like the full Moon stationed in the sky.

sa: यानि वैश्रवणे सुभ्र रत्नानि च धनानि च। तानि लोकांश्च सुश्रोणि मया भुझ्व यथासुखम्॥
en: O you having beautiful eye brows and welldeveloped hips, do you, along with me, enjoy at your pleasure all the wealth and riches of Kubera. "The God of wealth or Pluto in Greak myth.

sa: श्रुत्वा रामायणमिदं दीर्घमायुश्च विन्दति। रामस्य विजयं चेमं सर्वमक्लिष्टकर्मणः॥
en: Hearing the story of this work describing the victory of Rāma of unwearied actions one may attain to a long life.

sa: स तूर्णतरमादाय वहेमाङ्गदो गदाम्। अभिदुद्राव रक्षांसि तमांसीव दिवाकरः॥
en: And taking up speedily his club, that one, always using golden clubs, pursued the Rakşasas like to darkness following the sun.

sa: प्राप्तव्यं तु दशायोगान्मयैतदिति निश्चितम्। दासीनां रावणस्याहं मर्षयामीह दुर्बला॥
en: I forgive, out of pity, all these she-servants of Rāvaņa; they used to torture me at the command of that Raksasa.

sa: मन्त्रे व्यूहे नये चारे युक्तो भवितुमर्हसि। वानराणां च भद्रं ते परेषां च परंतप॥
en: O slayer of foes, it now behove you to be particularly careful about the counsels, arrangement of soldiers, polity-civil and military and spies of our own party as well as those of the enemies.

sa: ततो विचित्रकेयूरमुकुटेन विभूषितः। तनुत्रं च समावृत्य सधनुर्निर्ययौ द्रुतम्॥
en: Then decked out with curious keyūras and a tiara, and wearing armour, he rushed out with his bow in his hand.

sa: याच्यमानः सुबहुशो मया हितचिकीर्षुणा। वैदेहीमुत्सृजस्वेति न च तत्कृतवान्वचः॥
en: I, seeking his welfare, had besought him much, saying, 'Let go Vaidehi', but he did not act up to my speech.

sa: भवतामननुज्ञातो विक्रमो मे रुणद्धि माम्॥ सागरोऽप्यतियाद् वेलां मन्दरः प्रचलेदपि। न जाम्बवन्तं समरे कम्पयेदरिवाहिनी॥
en: Without your permission my prowess has been bought to a stand still. Even if the ocean overflow its banks, the Mount Mandara move off its place, the enemy's host cannot frighten Jāmbavăn in conflict.

sa: तांस्तु सर्वान्विनिर्मिद्य तदत्रमपहत्य च। जघ्नुस्ते राक्षसं घोरमेकं शतसहस्रशः॥
en: And snapping those weapons and resisting (those volleys of) arms, they smote at the Räkșasa fighting alone by hundreds and thousands.

sa: ततस्तद्वानरं सैन्यमचिन्त्यं लोमहर्षणम्। संख्यातुं नाध्यगच्छेतां तदा तौ शुकसारणौ॥
en: But Suka and Sāraṇa could not number that army of monkeys, incomprehensible and capable of making people's hair stand on end.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण त्वरमाणो विभीषणः। प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं सीतां स्त्रीभिः स्वाभिरचोदयत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, Vibhişaņa hastened on and entering the inner apartment sent information to Sītă through the female attendants.

sa: ततो यूपशताकीर्णं सौम्यचैत्योपशोभितम्। ददर्श विष्ठितं यज्ञं श्रिया संप्रज्वलनिव॥
en: There, he saw, filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts and altars, a sacrifice being celebrated, as if burning in its lustre.

sa: एष हन्ति गजानीकमेष हन्ति महारथान्। एष हन्ति शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पदातीन्वाजिभिः सह॥ इति ते राक्षसाः सर्वे रामस्य सदृशारणे। अन्योन्यं कुपिता जघ्नुः सादृश्याद्राघवस्य तु॥
en: It is he who is destroying the soldiers riding the elephants, it he who is breaking down the mighty cars, and it is he who with sharp arrows is slaying the cavalry-rider and horse. "Thus saying those Räkşasas, in that conflict and in the very presence of Rāma, highly enraged began to slay each other.

sa: विजित्य पृथिवीं सर्वां नानानगरमालिनीम्। जनकाय प्रदास्यामि तव हेतोर्विलासिनि॥
en: O sportive damsel, for your satisfaction, I shall conquer the whole earth, engarlanded by many cities and bestow it upon Janaka.

sa: मातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। अमर्षमतुलं लेभे प्रतिज्ञां चाकरोत्तदा।॥
en: Hearing that speech of his mother, the powerful Ten-necked one was wrought up with exceeding great ill-will, and he vowed then.

sa: तमङ्गदगतो राम लक्ष्मणः शुभया गिरा।॥ उवाच परिपूर्णार्थं पूर्णार्थप्रतिभानवान्।
en: Then Lakşmaņa, furnished with consummate sense and promptitude, who was mounted on Angada spoke to Rāma, inviting words, fraught with import.

sa: स त्वर्जुनप्रयुक्तेन गदाघातेन रावणः। अपासर्पद्धनुर्मानं निषसाद च निष्टनन्॥
en: Still wounded by the mace of Arjuna, Rāvana, shedding tears, ran away at a distance of four feet and sat there.

sa: रावणोऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः।॥ गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे।
en: The lord of Raksasas, Ravana, who was stationed on the car wroth, attacked Rāma in the conflict with maces and Musalas.

sa: ततस्तृप्त इति ज्ञात्वा समुत्पेतुर्निशाचराः। शिरोभिश्च प्रणम्यैनं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: And concluding that he was replete, the nightrangers came up; and bowing down their heads stood circling him on all sides.

sa: अहं राक्षसराजस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः। आज्ञाप्रतीक्षा दुर्धर्षा रक्षामि नगरीमिमाम्॥
en: I, who am incapable of being repressed, abiding by the mandate of the high-souled sovereign of the Rākşasas, protect this city.

sa: रावणस्यापनीतेन दुविनीतस्य दुर्मतेः। अयं निष्टानको घोरः शोकेन समभिप्लुतः॥
en: Alas! for the foolishness of the vicious minded and insolent Răvaņa destruction has faced us and we are overwhelmed with grief.

sa: भङ्क्त्वा प्रासादशिखरं नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः। विनद्य सुमहनादमुत्पपात विहायसा॥
en: Having reft the top of the edifice, and proclaimed his name, Angada, setting up a mighty roar, sprang into the sky.

sa: तन्मर्षयतु यच्चोक्तं गुरुत्वाद्धितमिच्छता। आत्मानं सर्वथा रक्ष पुरीं चेमां सराक्षसाम्। स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि सुखी भव मया विना॥
en: You are worshipful to me, do you forgive me for what I have said for your welfare. Do you protect yourself and this city, abounding in Raksasas. May good betide you! I am going away and do you be happy without me.

sa: प्रादीपवद् दाशरथेस्तदा शोकहुताशनम्॥ शायितं च चिरं तेन दुःखार्तेन महात्मना। मयापि विविधैर्वाक्यैः कृच्छादुत्थापितः पुनः॥
en: They inflamed the more Dasarathi's (Son of Dasaratha-Rāma) grief. And being overwhelmed with grief that high-souled one laid himself low on the ground. And consoling him in various words, I raised him up again.

sa: पर्वतस्येव शिखरं यथा वज्रविदारितम्। प्रापतत्सागरजले तथासौ विनिपातितः॥ एवं स रावणो राम श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिभिः। युवतीभिर्विगृह्याशु भ्रामितश्च ततस्ततः॥ नारदोऽपि महातेजा रावणं प्राप्य धर्षितम्। विस्मयं सुचिरं कृत्वा प्रजहास ननर्त च॥ एतदर्थ महाबाहो रावणेन दुरात्मना। विज्ञायापहृता सीता त्वत्तो मरणकाझ्या॥ भवान्नारायणो देवः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः। शाईपद्मायुधो वजी सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः॥ श्रीवत्साङ्को हृषीकेशः सर्वदेवाभिपूजितः। पद्मनाभो महायोगी भक्तानामभयप्रदः॥ वधार्थं रावणस्य त्वं प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम्। किं न वेत्सि
en: The females, inhabiting that insular continent again and again in this wise hurled Rāvaņa. Beholding his thus distressed the highly effulgent Nārada danced in joy and surprise. O you having long arms, being apprised of this, the vicioussouled Răvaņa stole away Sită with a view to meet death at your hands. You are Narayana, holding discuss, conch and club; you have in your hands the bow, a lotus, thunder-bolt and other weapons; you are worshipped of all deities; you are graced with the mystic mark Sribatsa, adored by all celestials, have a lotus navel, are a great ascetic, and Harishikesha declaring fearlessness to all devotees. You have assumed a human form to bring about the destruction of Ravana. Do you not recognise yourself as Nārāyaṇa? O great one, do not forget yourself; do you recol

sa: सन्ति चौघबलाः केचित् सन्ति वायुबलोपमाः। अप्रमेयबलाः केचित्तत्रासन् हरियूथपाः॥
en: some are equal in strength to the Wind, and there are there some monkey-leaders who have no limit to their strength.

sa: विनाशयन्तो भर्तारं सहिताः शत्रुभिर्बुधैः। विपरीतानि कृत्यानि कारयन्तीह मन्त्रिणः॥
en: Some counsellors-destroyers of their mastersjoining intelligent enemies (of their lords), act in a way opposed to their interests in this world.

sa: अथाहमुत्तरं देव्या पुनरुक्तः ससम्भ्रमम्। तव स्नेहान्नरव्याघ्र सौहार्दादनुमान्य च॥
en: Thereupon, O foremost of men, out of your love and adoring me for your friendship, that worshipful dame-addressed me again, saying.

sa: शरहोमसमिद्धस्य विधूमस्य महार्चिषः। बभूवुस्तानि लिङ्गानि विजयं दर्शयन्ति च।९।।
en: The fire, with oblations of sara, became greatly blazed and devoid of smoke. There were visible many good omens indicating victory.

sa: अतः परमतीरोऽयं सागरः सरितां पतिः। च चायमनुपायेन शक्यस्तरितुमर्णवः॥
en: This ocean, the lord of the streams, whose other side is not seen, cannot be crossed over without some excellent measure.

sa: हनुमान् मेघजालानि प्राकर्षन् मारुतो यथा। कालागुरुसवर्णानि रक्तपीतसितानि च॥
en: And mighty clouds, hued like Kālāguru red, and yellow and sable, on being disperse I by the monkey, burst into brilliance.

sa: ततो भ्रातरमासीनं कुम्भकर्णोऽब्रवीद्वचः। निद्रा मां बाधते राजन्कारयस्व ममालयम्॥
en: Then Kumbhakarņa spoke to his brother, who was seated, 'O king, Sleep obstructs me. Do you, therefore, have my mansion made.

sa: ऋषयः पितरो देवा गन्धर्वगरुडोरगाः। शतक्रतुं पुरस्कृत्य ररक्षुर्लक्ष्मणं रणे॥
en: Saints and Pitrs and deities and Gandharvas and birds and serpents, placing Satakratu in their front, protected Laksmana in the conflict.

sa: उत्सहेयमहं गत्वा त्वद्वाक्यमसितेक्षणे। निवेद्य कुशलं रामे प्रतिच्छना निवर्तितुम्॥
en: O you having dark eyes, I can, secretly going to Rama and communicating to him your auspicious words, come back clandestinely.

sa: आपतन्तं शरौघेण वारयामास राघव। उत्पतन्तं युगान्ताग्नि जलौघैरिव वासवः॥
en: And with vollies of shafts Räghava resisted the descending (dart), even as Vāsava extinguish the fire of doomsday with his showers.

sa: सा श्रुत्वा निश्चयं तस्य निश्चयज्ञा दुरात्मनः। पुनरेवागमत्क्षिप्रमशोकवनिका शुभाम्॥
en: Having heard of the decision of that wickedminded one, she, understanding decisions, swiftly retraced her steps to the fair Asoka forest.

sa: सर्वे पर्वतसंकाशाः सर्वे पर्वतयोधिनः। सर्वे दीप्तायुधधरा योधास्तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: All the warriors of the high-souled one are like mountain and fight with crags; and all are equipped with flaming weapons.

sa: ततः कुम्भं समुत्क्षिप्य सुग्रीवो लवणाम्भसि। पातयामास वेगेन दर्शयन्नुदधेः स्थलम्॥ ततः कुम्भनिपातेन जलराशिः समुत्थितः। विन्ध्यमन्दरसंकाशो विससर्प समन्ततः॥
en: Then Sugrīva lifting up Kumbha clean, violently plunged him into the salt wash, making his eyes acquainted with the locality of the deep. And in consequence of Kumbha's plunge, the waters heaving up, rolled on all sides like the Vindhya or Mandara.

sa: पितामह उवाच भक्षार्थं विक्रयार्थं वा येऽपहारं हि कुर्वते। दानार्थं ब्राह्मणार्थाय तत्रेदं श्रूयतां फलम्॥
en: The Grandfather said Hear of the consequences that befall those persons who steal a cow for killing her for food or selling her for money, or making a gift of her to a Brahmana.

sa: स चेत् त्वामनुयुञ्जीत ममानुगमनेप्सया। शंसेथा वह्निमारूढं मामपि त्वमशङ्कया॥
en: And if he should ask you to follow me, you must tell him unhesitatingly that I have entered into the fire.

sa: मरुत्त उवाच संजीविताऽहं भवता वाक्येनानेन नारद। पश्येयं क्व न संवर्तं शंस मे वदतां वर॥ कथं च तस्मै वर्तेयं कथं मां न परित्यजेत्। प्रत्याख्यातश्च तेनापि नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: Marutta said I feel as if filled with new life, by these your words, O Narada, but O the best of speakers, do you tell me where I can find Samvarta, and how I can remain by his side, and how I ma to act so that he may not leave inc, for I do not wish to live if I mcet with a refusal from him also.

sa: शुद्धो ह्यर्थो नावमन्यस्व धर्मान् पात्रे देयं देशकालोपपन्ने। तस्माद् गावस्ते नित्यमेव प्रदेया मा भूच्च ते संशयः कश्चिदत्र॥
en: The subject is fraught with sanctity. Do you never disregard the duties of gifts. Gifts, again, should be made to worth persons, when time and place are suitable. Do you, therefore, always make gifts of kine. Never entertain any doubt about it.

sa: मरुत्त उवाच पित्र्यमस्मि तव क्षेत्रं बहु मन्ये च ते भृशम्। तवास्मि याज्यतां प्राप्तो भजमानं भजस्व माम्॥
en: Marutta said You are our hereditary family-priest, and therefore I cherish great regard for you, and I have acquired the right of being helped at sacrifices by you, and therefore it is proper that you should officiate as priest at my sacrifice.

sa: मासंप्रकारान् विविधाशाकानि विविधानि च। वेसवारविकारांश्च पानकानि लघूनि च॥
en: There were various kinds of meat and different preparations also thereof. There was a great variety of vegetables also and potherbs.

sa: ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य शिरोभिः प्रणिपत्य च। ब्राह्मणानग्निसहितान् प्रययुः पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥
en: The Pandavas, going round many Brahmanas who daily adored their fires, and bending their heads unto them, proceeded on their journey.

sa: मया ह्यन्तर्हितानीह बिसानीमानि पश्यत। परीक्षार्थं भगवतां कृतमेवं मयानघाः॥
en: Before you all I have made those stalks disappear. You sinless ones, the act was done by me for testing you.

sa: संधाय संधाय शरांश्चिक्षेप किल भार्गवः। तान् क्षिप्तान् रेणुका सर्वांस्तस्येषून्दीप्ततेजसः॥ आनीय सा तदा तस्मै प्रादादसकृदच्युत। अथ तेन स शब्देन ज्यायाश्चैव शरस्य च॥ प्रहृष्टः सम्प्रचिक्षेप सा च प्रत्याजहार तान्। ततो मध्याह्नमारूढे ज्येष्ठामूले दिवाकरे॥ स सायकान् द्विजो मुक्त्वा रेणुकामिदमब्रवीत्। गच्छानय विशालाक्षि शरानेतान् धनुश्च्युतान्॥
en: Taking his aim, he shot arrow after arrow. His wife Renuka used to pick up the arrows when he shot and repeatedly bring them back to that descendant, gifted with the burning energy of Bhrigu's race. pleased with the whizzing noise of his arrows and the twang of his bow, he amused himself thus by repeatedly shooting his arrows which Renuka brought back to him, One day, at noontide, O monarch, was in that month when the Sun in Jyesthamula, the Brahmana, having shot all his arrows, said to Renuka, O largeeyed lady, go and fetch me the arrows I have shot from my bow.

sa: यम उवाच नाहं कालस्य विहितं प्राप्नोमीह कथंचन। यो हि धर्मं चरति वै तं तु जानामि केवलम्॥
en: Yama said I cannot determine the exact period, ordained by Time, of one's life, and hence, unurged by Time, I cannot allow one to live here. I take note of the acts of virtue (or otherwise) that one does in the world.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मया गवां पुरीषं वै श्रिया जुष्टमिति श्रुतम्। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं संशयोऽत्र पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said I have heard that the dung of the cow is gifted with prosperity. I wish to hear how this has been occasioned. I have doubts, O grand father which you should remove.

sa: राजर्षीणां पुराणानामनुयातु गतिं नृपः। राजर्षीणां हि सर्वेषामन्ते वनमुपाश्रयः॥
en: Let this king follow the path of royal sages of old. Indeed, all royal sages retire into the woods at last.

sa: आच्छाद्य च महाबाहुर्धनतृष्णामपानुदत्। ब्राह्मणानां तदा कृष्णस्तदभूल्लोमहर्षणम्॥ सुवर्णं चैव गाश्चैव शयनाच्छादनानि च। दीयमानं तदा विप्रा वर्धतामिति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: Presenting many clothes to them, Krishna satisfied the thirst for wealth of those Brahmanas. Wonderful were the heaps of gold, the number of kine and of beds and cloths, that were then given away. The Brahmanas loudly declared, Let (Krishna's wealth) increase.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दारा इत्युच्यते लोके नाम्नैकेन परतंपा प्रोक्तेन चैव नाम्नायं विशेषः सुमहान् भवेत्॥
en: Bhishma said O destroyer of enemies, all wives in this world are called by the name of Dara. Although that name is applied to all, yet there is this great difference to be observed.

sa: तेभ्यः प्रसूतास्तेष्वेव महाभूतेषु पञ्चसु। प्रलीयन्ते यथाकालमूर्मयः सागरे यथा॥
en: All that originates from them dissolves, when the time comes, in those very five great elements like billows in the ocean.

sa: ब्राह्मे लोके वसन्त्येताः सोमेन सह भारत॥ यां तो ब्रह्मर्षयः सिद्धाः प्रार्थयन्ति परां गतिम्।
en: Kine, O Bharata, live in the region of Brahman, in the company of Soma. Forming, as it does the highest end, the twiceborn Rishis, crowned with success, try to attain to that very region.

sa: स प्रविश्य गृहं राजन् कृतपूर्वाहिकक्रियः। तर्पयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठानाहारमकरोत् तदा॥
en: Entering his palace, O king, he performed the morning rites and, after pleasing many foremost of Brahmanas, he took some food.

sa: ततो देवा महात्मान ईजिरे यज्ञमच्युतम्॥ तथा समापयामासुर्यथाकालं सुरर्षभाः।
en: The great deities then. O you of unfading glory, celebrated their sacrifice. Those foremost of gods finished it in due time.

sa: तस्य पुत्रशतं राजन्नासीत् परधार्मिकम्। तांस्तु सर्वान् महीपालानिक्ष्वाकुरकरोत् प्रभुः॥
en: He, O king, had a hundred sons possessed of pre-eminent picty. And all of them were inade monarchs by king Ikshvaku.

sa: तामुवाच स देवर्षिः सत्यं वद सुमध्यमे। मृषावादे भवेद् दोषः सत्ये दोषो न विद्यते॥
en: It is very To her the celestial Rishi said true, O you of slender waist! One commits sin by speaking what is untrue. In saying however, what is true, there can be no sin.

sa: तत्र तस्यासतः कालः समतीतोऽभवन्महान्। ततः कदाचित् समये कस्मिंश्चिन्मत्स्यजीविनः॥
en: In this way, the Rishi passed a long time at that grand confluence of waters. One day, some fishermen came there.

sa: नास्ति वेदात् परं शास्त्रं नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः। न धर्मात् परमो लाभस्तपो नानशनात् परम्॥
en: There is no Shastra superior to the Veda. There is no person more worthy of respect than the mother. There is no acquisition superior to that of virtue, and no penance superior to fast.

sa: ततो राजा महावीर्यो नहुषः पृथिवीपतिः। परमित्यब्रवीत् प्रीतस्तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: Then the highly energetic king Nahusha that lord of all the Earth, filled with joy, O best of the Bharatas, said-Sufficient.

sa: मध्याह्ने वै निमेषार्धं तिष्ठसि त्वं दिवाकर। तत्र भेत्स्यामि सूर्य त्वां न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा॥
en: At midday you appear to stay in the firmament for a moment. It is then, O Sun, that I shall pierce you with my arrows! There is no swerving from this resolution of mine.

sa: न सुतैर्न च वित्तेन कर्मणा न च तत्फलम्। प्राप्नुयात् पुरुषोऽत्यन्तं गङ्गां प्राप्य यदाप्नुयात्॥
en: The merit that one acquires by bathing in Ganga is such that the like of it is incapable of being acquired through the acquisition of sons or riches or the performance of meritorious acts.

sa: अखादन्ननुमोदंश्च भावदोषेण मानवः। योऽनुमोदति हन्यन्तं सोऽपि दोषेण लिप्यते॥
en: He who does not himself eat flesh but approves of an act of slaughter, becomes stained with the sin of slaughter.

sa: दक्षिणं च मुखं रौद्रं केनोर्चे कपिला जटाः। केन कण्ठश्च ते नीलो बर्हिवर्हनिभः कृतः॥
en: And why is that face of yours which is on the truth so dreadful? Why are your matted locks tawny in colour and so erect? Why is your throat blue like the peacock's plumes?

sa: तिष्ठेथा राजशार्दूल वैतसी वृत्तिमास्थितः। यद्येनमभियायाच्च बलवान् दुर्बलं नृपः॥
en: If a strong king advances against a weak one, the latter should make him desist, by adopting conciliatory and other modes.

sa: ततः पुनरभिक्रुद्धो राजा प्राग्ज्योतिषाधिपः। प्रेषयामास नागेन्द्रं बलवत् पर्वतोपमम्॥
en: Once more the king of the Pragjyotishas, worked up with rage, forcibly urged his elephant, which resembled a mountain, at Arjuna.

sa: तत्राश्रमपदं धीमानभिगम्य स पार्थिवः। आससादाथ राजर्षि शतयूपं मनीषिणम्॥
en: Endued with great intelligence, the king arrived at the hermitage of the royal sage Shatayupa of grcat wisdom and saw him.

sa: अपास्ताश्च तथा राजन् विकुर्वन्ति मनः स्त्रियः। इमाः प्रजा महाबाहो धार्मिक्य इति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: Living creatures, O you of mighty arms are virtuous. Even this is what we have heard. Treated with love and respect or otherwise women are seen to deserve censure for their conduct towards men.

sa: प्रौष्ठपदं तु यो मासमेकाहारो भवेन्नरः। गवाढ्यं स्फीतमचलमैश्वर्यं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: That man who takes himself only one meal a day for the whole month of Proshthapada, becomes possessed of great riches.

sa: इन्येवमुक्त्वा नृपते धनंजयसुतो नृपः। उपस्पृश्याभवत् तूष्र्णी प्रायोपेतो महामतिः॥
en: Having bewailed thus, the great son of Dhananjaya, king Babhruvahana, touched water and became silent, vowing to starve himself to death.

sa: एवमङ्गिरसश्चैव कवेश्च प्रसवान्वयैः। भृगोश्च भृगुशार्दूल वंशजैः सततं जगत्॥
en: Thus, O chief of Bhrigu's race, has the whole world been peopled with the children of Angirasa, and Kavi and Bhrigu,

sa: द्वारकामनुसम्प्राप्तं नारदं देवदर्शनम्। पप्रच्छेदं वचः प्रश्नं देवकी धर्मदर्शनम्॥
en: Once on a time when Narada of godlike features and knowing every duty arrived at Dwaraka, Devaki asked him this question.

sa: बलयः सह पुष्पैस्तु देवानामुपहारयेत्। दधिदुग्धमयाः पुण्याः सुगन्धाः प्रियदर्शनाः॥
en: Clean food, of sweet scent and look, mixed with milk and curds, should, along with flowers, be offered to the celestials.

sa: सेन्द्रेषु चैव लोकेषु प्रतिष्ठां विन्दते शुभाम्। इह लोके यशः प्राप्य शान्तपाप्मा च मोदते॥
en: Such a man acquires fame in regions of great happiness that belong to Indra himself. Acquiring great fame in this world also, and purged of all his sins, he sports on joy and happiness.

sa: तं तु राजा प्रतोदेन चोदयामास भारत। न चुकोप स धर्मात्मा ततः पादेन देवराट्॥ अगस्त्यस्य तदा क्रुद्धो वामेनाभ्यहनच्छिरः। तस्मिन्शिरस्यभिहते स जटान्तर्गतो भृगुः॥ शशाप बलवत्क्रुद्धो नहुषं पापचेतसम्। यस्मात् पदाऽऽहतः कोधाच्छिरसीमं महामुनिम्॥ तस्मादाशु महीं गच्छ सर्पो भूत्वा सुदुर्मते। इत्युक्तः स तदा तेन सर्पो भूत्वा पपात ह॥ अदृष्टेनाथ भृगुणा भूतले भरतर्षभ। भृगुं हि यदि सोऽद्रक्ष्यन्नहुषः पृथिवीपते॥ न च शक्तोऽभविष्यद् वै पातने तस्य तेजसा। स तु तैस्तैः प्रदानैश्च तपोभिर्नियमैस्तथा॥ पतितोऽपि महाराज भूतले
en: Then, O Bharata, king Nahusha urged Agastya on with his goad. The pious Rishi did not still yield to anger. The lord of the celestials, himself enraged, then struck Agastya on the head with his left foot. When the Rishi was thus struck on the head, Bhrigu, who was living within Agastya's matted locks became incensed and cursed the sinful Nahusha, saying, Since you have struck with your foot on the head of this great Rishi, do you, therefore, fall down on the Earth, changed into a snake, O wretch of wicked understanding! Thus, imprecated by Bhrigu who had not been seen Nahusha, forthwith became transformed into a snake and dropped down on the Earth, O chief of Bharata's race! If, O monarch, Nahusha had seçn Bhrigu, the latter would not then have succeeded, by his power, in hurling the forne

sa: युधिष्ठिरं च राजानं भीमादींश्चापि पाण्डवान्॥ उपगम्य महातेजा विनयेनाभ्यवादयत्।
en: Going then to king Yudhishthira and Bhima and the other Pandavas the mighty prince of Munipura saluted them all with humility.

sa: सर्वेष्वपररात्रेषु सूतमागधबन्दिनः। स्तुवन्ति मां यथा देवा महेन्द्रं प्रियवादिनः॥
en: Towards the dawn bards and encomiasts sing my praises even as the deities utter the agreeable praises of Indra their chief.

sa: देवशर्मन् उवाच यज्ञकारो गमिष्यामि रुचिं चेमां सुरेश्वरः॥ यतः प्रार्थयते नित्यं तां रक्षस्व यथाबलम्।
en: Devasharman said I shall leave home in order to celebrate a sacrifice. The king of the celestials always covets this Ruchi of mine. Do you, during my absence, protect her, displaying all your power.

sa: वध्यमानाः पार्थेन हयमुत्सृज्य सम्भ्रमात्॥ न्यवर्तन्त महाराज शरवर्षार्दिता भृशम्।
en: While thus killed by Partha, the Gandharas, O king, exceedingly afflicted, liberated the horse, moved by fear and desisted from battle.

sa: श्रोत्रं त्वक् चक्षुषी जिह्वा नासिका चरणौ करो। उपस्थं वायुरिति वा होतृणि दश भामिनि॥
en: The ear, the skin, the two eyes, the tongue, the nose, the two feet, the two hands, the genital organ, the lower duct, and speech, these, O beautiful one, are the ten sacrificing priests.

sa: देवासुरमनुष्याणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्। पिशाचकिन्नराणां च पूज्या वै पितरः सदा॥
en: Gods or Asuras human beings, Gandharvas or Uragas or Rakshasas, Pishachas or Kinnaras, every one should always adore the departed Manes.

sa: मरुत उवाच आश्चर्यमद्य पश्यामि रूपिणं वह्निमागतम्। आसनं सलिलं पाद्यं गां चोपानय वै मुने॥
en: Marutta said See! I find the Fire-God come in his own embodiment, this day, therefore, do you, O Muni, offer him a seat and water, and a cow and water for washing the feet.

sa: अग्नि उवाच आसनं सलिलं पाद्यं प्रतिनन्दामि तेऽनघ। इन्द्रेण तु समादिष्टं विद्धि मां दूतमागतम्॥
en: Agni said I accept your offerings of water, seat, and water for washing the feet, O sinless one, do you know me as the messenger of Indra, come to you as ordered by him.

sa: खरो जीवति वर्षाणि दस पञ्च च भारत। खरो मृतो बलीवर्दः सप्त वर्षाणि जीवति॥
en: He has to live as an ass for fifteen years, Shaking off his assinine form, he has next to take birth as an ox and which state he has to live for seven years.

sa: तेन दत्तानि दानानि पापेनाशुद्धबुद्धिना। तानि सर्वानादृत्य नश्यन्ति विपुलान्यपि।॥
en: Gifts made by a sinner with an impure heart, for this, when very large, become lost. Such gifts go for nothing.

sa: मुहूर्तमथ संचिन्त्य ब्राह्मणस्तस्य रक्षसः। आभिर्गाथाभिरव्यग्रः प्रश्न प्रतिजगाद ह॥
en: Reflecting for a short time, the Brahmana accepted the question of the Rakshasa and replied in the following well spoken words.

sa: मनसश्च पृथिव्याश्च पुण्यास्तीर्थास्तथापरे। उभयोरेव यःस्नायात् स सिद्धिं शीघ्रमाप्नुयात्॥
en: The mental Tirthas are separate and distinct from those of the Earth. That person who bathes in both acquires success forthwith.

sa: भीष्म उवाच विपन्नकृत्या राजेन्द्र देवता ऋषयस्तथा। कृत्तिकाश्चोदयामासुरपत्यभरणाय वै॥
en: Bhishma said The gods and the Rishis, O king reduced to great distress, urged the six Krittikas to rear that child.

sa: ततस्ते वध्यमानास्तु हतयूथाः प्लवंगमाः। वानरा भयसंविग्ना विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः॥
en: Thus beaten (by Kumbhakarna), those monkeys, with their ranks destroyed, the monkeys, racked with anxiety, began to cry in unnatural tones.

sa: स एव सुखसंस्पर्शो वाति चन्दनशीतलः। गन्धमभ्यवहन् पुण्यं श्रमापनयनोऽनिलः॥
en: The sandal-cool wind, of pleasant touch, ever removing the exhaustion of toil, is blowing every where carrying with it pure fragrance.
